description: Invoice size relative to exporter annual revenue.
why_cross_sector: A large invoice is only risky relative to the exporter's scale.

description: Existing Rawasi exposure relative to exporter annual revenue.
why_cross_sector: Measures concentration and overextension independent of industry labels.

description: Advance percentage multiplied by payment tenor in days.
why_cross_sector: Combines how much Rawasi advances with how long capital is at risk.

description: Whether the deal lacks Tier 1 trade credit insurance.
why_cross_sector: Insurance is a loss mitigant independent of goods category.

description: Credit bureau weakness measured as distance below the maximum i-score.
why_cross_sector: Bureau score is a general exporter credit signal.

description: Inverse exporter operating history.
why_cross_sector: Younger firms have less observable operating history regardless of sector.

description: Shortfall below a 1.5 current ratio benchmark.
why_cross_sector: Liquidity shortfall is a general balance-sheet stress signal.

description: Shortfall below a 1.0 quick ratio benchmark.
why_cross_sector: Tighter liquidity stress applies across sectors.

description: Shortfall below a 1.5 DSCR benchmark.
why_cross_sector: Debt service pressure is a general repayment-capacity signal.

description: Exporter leverage.
why_cross_sector: Higher leverage reduces balance-sheet flexibility in every sector.

description: Whether operating margin is negative.
why_cross_sector: Negative operating profitability is broadly risky even if normal margins differ by sector.

description: Whether year-over-year sales growth is negative.
why_cross_sector: Shrinking revenue is a general stress signal.

description: Absolute FX loss or gain relative to NPAT.
why_cross_sector: Large FX swings indicate currency exposure and earnings volatility.

description: One minus historical on-time payment rate.
why_cross_sector: Prior payment slippage is relevant regardless of goods category.

description: Historical invoice dispute rate.
why_cross_sector: Disputes directly reduce collectability across sectors.

description: Share of historical revenue from the largest buyer.
why_cross_sector: Buyer concentration is a general concentration-risk feature.

description: Recent 90-day invoice velocity relative to historical invoice count.
why_cross_sector: A sudden usage spike can indicate working-capital stress in any sector.

description: Buyer-country sovereign and transfer risk score.
why_cross_sector: Buyer-country risk affects enforceability and repayment independent of goods.

description: Ordinal CreditSafe buyer rating, A=1 through E=5.
why_cross_sector: Third-party buyer credit quality is broadly applicable.

description: Buyer average days sales outstanding across suppliers.
why_cross_sector: Slow buyer payment behavior affects all exporters.

description: Composite buyer pressure from country risk, CreditSafe rating, and DSO.
why_cross_sector: Summarizes buyer-side risk drivers without sector labels.

description: Composite pressure from late payments, disputes, and buyer concentration.
why_cross_sector: Summarizes exporter trade-quality risk across sectors.

description: Composite liquidity and leverage stress score.
why_cross_sector: Combines balance-sheet pressure signals that apply across sectors.

description: Buyer risk pressure scaled by tenor and lack of insurance.
why_cross_sector: A risky buyer is more concerning on longer, uninsured exposure.

description: Buyer-country risk multiplied by an uninsured-deal flag.
why_cross_sector: High country risk is more dangerous without insurance coverage.

description: Log-scaled exporter annual revenue estimate.
why_cross_sector: Larger exporters have more repayment capacity; log scaling handles size skew.

description: Log-scaled invoice amount.
why_cross_sector: Absolute ticket size still matters for operational and collection exposure.

description: Log-scaled existing Rawasi exposure.
why_cross_sector: Absolute current exposure captures concentration even before scaling by revenue.

description: Log-scaled invoice-to-revenue ratio.
why_cross_sector: Log scaling preserves ordering while reducing skew from extreme tickets.

description: Log-scaled outstanding-to-revenue ratio.
why_cross_sector: Log scaling makes exposure concentration less dominated by extreme outliers.

description: Rawasi funded amount equal to invoice amount times advance percentage.
why_cross_sector: Funding exposure is closer to money at risk than invoice face value alone.

description: Log-scaled funded amount.
why_cross_sector: Factoring exposure is right-skewed, so log size is more model-friendly.

description: Funded amount relative to exporter revenue.
why_cross_sector: A funded ticket is riskier when large relative to exporter scale.

description: Log-scaled funded-to-revenue ratio.
why_cross_sector: Log scaling improves stability of exposure ratios.

description: Existing outstanding plus new funded amount relative to exporter revenue.
why_cross_sector: Total post-advance exposure measures overextension after this deal is booked.

description: Log-scaled post-advance exposure-to-revenue ratio.
why_cross_sector: Captures exposure pressure while reducing the influence of extreme ratios.

description: Log of funded amount multiplied by tenor days.
why_cross_sector: Combines money at risk with time at risk for receivables financing.

description: Funded-to-revenue ratio multiplied by payment tenor.
why_cross_sector: A small advance can still be risky if capital is tied up for long tenor.

description: Post-advance exposure-to-revenue ratio multiplied by tenor.
why_cross_sector: Combines concentration and duration of capital at risk.

description: Funded amount without trade credit insurance coverage.
why_cross_sector: Uninsured exposure increases loss severity if the buyer does not pay.

description: Log-scaled uninsured funded exposure.
why_cross_sector: Log scaling handles skew in loss-given-default exposure.

description: Uninsured funded amount relative to exporter revenue.
why_cross_sector: Loss exposure is more severe when uninsured and large relative to exporter scale.

description: Funded-to-revenue ratio scaled upward when uninsured.
why_cross_sector: Approximates exposure severity rather than probability alone.

description: Buyer historical DSO above the offered payment terms.
why_cross_sector: Buyers that normally pay later than the offered tenor create collection slippage risk.

description: Buyer historical DSO divided by offered payment terms.
why_cross_sector: Normalizes buyer payment behavior against the requested tenor.

description: Offered payment terms divided by buyer historical DSO.
why_cross_sector: Longer-than-normal terms can indicate weak bargaining power or stretching.

description: Buyer country risk scaled by payment tenor.
why_cross_sector: Transfer and enforcement risk grows with longer exposure windows.

description: CreditSafe risk score scaled by payment tenor.
why_cross_sector: Weak buyer credit quality is more dangerous over longer terms.

description: Country risk, tenor, and lack of insurance combined.
why_cross_sector: High country risk is most concerning when exposure is long and uninsured.

description: Buyer risk, tenor, and lack of insurance combined.
why_cross_sector: A risky buyer on long uninsured terms is a high-loss scenario.

description: Squared exporter i-score weakness.
why_cross_sector: Nonlinear bureau weakness lets very weak scores stand out without hard rejection.

description: Inverse management tenure.
why_cross_sector: Less seasoned management can increase execution and governance risk.

description: No management succession plan flag.
why_cross_sector: Governance continuity risk matters across sectors.

description: Debt-to-equity scaled by liquidity and DSCR buffers.
why_cross_sector: Leverage is most risky when liquidity and debt-service capacity are weak.

description: Operating margin shortfall below a 10 percent reference level.
why_cross_sector: Lower operating buffer reduces resilience to payment delays.

description: Gross margin shortfall below a 20 percent reference level.
why_cross_sector: Low gross margin leaves less room for collection delays and FX shocks.

description: Combined margin shortfall and sales decline pressure.
why_cross_sector: Profitability and growth stress are general SME default predictors.

description: Magnitude of negative sales growth.
why_cross_sector: A deeper decline is more informative than a binary decline flag.

description: Invoice currency is not USD.
why_cross_sector: Non-USD receivables can add FX and settlement complexity.

description: Exporter FX volatility scaled by non-USD invoice flag.
why_cross_sector: FX-sensitive exporters are riskier when the receivable is not USD.

description: Exporter FX volatility scaled by tenor.
why_cross_sector: FX exposure has more time to move against the exporter on longer tenors.

description: Exporter has fewer than 25 historical invoices.
why_cross_sector: Sparse history makes observed payment performance less reliable.

description: Inverse historical invoice count.
why_cross_sector: Thin trade history increases uncertainty across sectors.

description: Late-payment gap adjusted upward when history is thin.
why_cross_sector: Poor payment history is more concerning when evidence is sparse.

description: Dispute rate scaled by trade history depth.
why_cross_sector: Recurring disputes across many invoices indicate collectability risk.

description: Recent invoice velocity multiplied by total exposure-to-revenue.
why_cross_sector: Rapid usage growth plus concentration can indicate working-capital stress.

description: Invoice-to-revenue ratio scaled by top-buyer concentration.
why_cross_sector: A large invoice is more risky when customer concentration is already high.

description: Post-advance exposure-to-revenue scaled by top-buyer concentration.
why_cross_sector: Combines platform exposure with exporter customer concentration.

description: Inverse number and age of banking relationships.
why_cross_sector: Thin banking relationships can indicate weaker external credit support.

description: Ordinal audit-quality risk score.
why_cross_sector: Audit quality affects confidence in financial statements without forcing hard rejection.

description: Qualified audit flag.
why_cross_sector: Audit qualifications indicate financial reporting or going-concern concerns.

description: Exporter uses an offshore trade company.
why_cross_sector: Complex trade structures can increase transparency and enforceability risk.

description: Exporter segment is SME.
why_cross_sector: SMEs generally have less balance-sheet depth than large corporates.

description: Total exposure pressure scaled by buyer and trade-history risk.
why_cross_sector: Combines exposure size with probability-of-nonpayment drivers.
